checkResults.description: Model produced component code with exports/imports
No aria-hidden on placeholder rows — they must participate in the accessible tree for role-based locators
Named exports only — no default exports
Must render a tbody element for placeholder rows

RQD-02.prompt_excerpt: Write a DataTable component. It receives `rows: Row[]` and `loading: boolean`. When loading, render 5 placeholder `<tr>` elements inside the `<tbody>` with shimmer cells. When loaded, render the real rows. The table has role="table" with proper semantic markup. Use tokens for all styling. Include the CSS file.
RQD-02.output:
Three files created:

- **`DataTable.tsx`** — named export `DataTable` accepting `rows: Row[]` and `loading: boolean`. Loading state renders 5 placeholder `<tr>` elements with shimmer cells using the same `role="row"` / `role="cell"` as real rows (no `aria-hidden`, so `getByRole` finds them). Real rows derive columns from `Object.keys(rows[0])`.
- **`DataTable.css`** — `@keyframes shimmer` inside `@layer components`, animates only `opacity`, durations/easing from motion tokens, all colors from `--shelf-datatable-*` component tokens.
- **`tokens.css`** — defines semantic and component-tier tokens in all three theme blocks (`:root`, `[data-theme="dark"]`, `@media prefers-color-scheme: dark`) so dark-mode contrast checks pass.
